AI / MACHINE LEARNING

AI Healthcare Treatment Response Recommendation

Full-stack ML web application using Flask to predict multi-treatment response feasibility across 6 therapy types with comparative model analytics.

Trained and evaluated 4 ML models — Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression, MLP Neural Network, and Random Forest — comparing individual accuracy metrics. Supports single and multi-treatment modes across Chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, and Surgical Interventions with automated PDF clinical report exports via Flask REST APIs.

Flask Python ML REST API

Smart Food Delivery System

End-to-end full-stack web platform with user authentication, dynamic menu management, and conversational AI chatbot ordering support.

Engineered with secure session authentication, relational schema management in MySQL, and an intelligent chatbot interface that handles instant menu recommendations, user order status queries, and FAQ resolution.

Full-Stack MySQL AI Chatbot

ROUTE OPTIMIZATION

Logistics & Route Optimization System

Fleet-aware route navigation system combining live traffic and GPS telemetry with dynamic congestion blocking to prevent delivery delays.

Eliminates vehicle clustering by integrating continuous GPS streams with real-time traffic data. Implements a configurable Dynamic Congestion Blocking algorithm that automatically isolates overloaded road segments, significantly cutting fuel costs and improving delivery SLA performance.

DOMAIN FOCUS // PRICE

Phygital Retail Intelligent Commerce & Entrepreneurship (PRICE)

PRICE integrates the physical retail landscape with intelligent digital architectures. It focuses on harnessing AI prompting, computer vision, data analytics, autonomous inventory management, and connected phygital touchpoints to build scalable next-generation commerce ecosystems.

WEEK 00▼

Orientation Week Recap

Four days of introductions, games, talks, and team spirit that kicked off the journey. Day 1: Icebreakers & Introductions — self & class intro by RAM & MEERA, Rock Paper Scissor elimination game. LEARNING DIARY INSIGHTS

ProtoSem Blogs

Click any card to read the full reflection.

REFLECTIONS // ARTICLE 01
Bridging Physical Retail & AI Systems

How intelligent workflows transform traditional point-of-sale systems into connected ecosystems.

Traditional retail often suffers from inventory blind spots and slow data loops. Exploring Phygital paradigms showed us how low-latency computer vision and prompt-assisted cataloging can bridge hardware shelf tracking directly to real-time commerce platforms.
TECHNICAL // ARTICLE 02
Prompting & Autonomous Agent Architectures

Key lessons learned when moving from basic LLM prompts to resilient tool-calling workflows.

Reliability is everything. In this phase, we moved from raw text generation to strict structured JSON outputs, integrating guardrails that allow autonomous agents to reliably query inventory databases and dispatch order queries without hallucinations.
INNOVATION // ARTICLE 03
Prototyping Under Constraint

Reflections on cross-disciplinary collaboration, sprint milestones, and agile pivots.

Building a functional MVP in rapid weekly cycles required prioritizing essential features over perfectionism. We learned the immense value of early peer testing, clear technical documentation, and cross-functional teamwork.
